name: N-Phenethylnordesomorphine
summary: N-Phenethylnordesomorphine is an opiate analgesic drug derived from desomorphine by replacing the N-methyl group with β-phenethyl.

pharmacology.text: Since desomorphine is already around eight times more potent than morphine, the additional boost in binding affinity produced by using the larger phenethyl group makes N-phenethylnordesomorphine a highly potent analgesic drug, some 85 times more potent than morphine, and a similar strength to the closely related morphinan derivative phenomorphan.

uses.en: It is a research compound and has never been approved as a medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，從未被核准作為藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，从未被核准作为药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing altogether. Because it is expected to be very potent, the risk of overdose and dependence would be high.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量時可能導致呼吸完全停止。由於預期藥效極強，過量與成癮的風險都會很高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量时可能导致呼吸完全停止。由于预期药效极强，过量与成瘾的风险都会很高。

fact.en: Its parent drug desomorphine was first made in the United States in the early 1930s, and decades later became known as the main drug in the crude homemade mixture called krokodil.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物去氧嗎啡在 1930 年代初於美國首次合成，數十年後成為簡陋自製混合物「鱷魚」（krokodil）中的主要成分而廣為人知。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物去氧吗啡在 1930 年代初于美国首次合成，数十年后成为简陋自制混合物「鳄鱼」（krokodil）中的主要成分而广为人知。
